headline: Profit growth outpaces revenue as margins expand
summary_short: Cintas reported revenue of $2,905.2M, up 8.9% y/y and 2.2% q/q, while diluted EPS rose 15.6% y/y to $1.26. Operating income grew 15.2% y/y, outpacing revenue growth.
summary_long: Revenue was $2,905.2M, up 8.9% y/y and 2.2% q/q. Gross margin expanded to about 51.0% of revenue from 49.7% a year earlier (+1.3ppt). EBIT rose 12.5% y/y to $674.3M and operating income rose 15.2% y/y to $688.2M, both outpacing revenue growth. Net income was $511.0M (+14.0% y/y), with net margin near 17.6% versus 16.8% a year ago. Diluted EPS rose 15.6% y/y to $1.26.
